problem_type: Onboarding completion ignores an explicit failed check
symptom: A zero-quota key shows a warning and emits a connected receipt after 450 ms.
direct_cause: The page completed verification using only accountBalance even when keyQuota explicitly reported zero.
class_root: The completion decision and its row warnings used different conditions for exhausted balances.
affected_population: Creators pasting or rechecking a limited key against a funded APIMart account.
entry_points: Paste a candidate key or recheck the saved credential when returning to the page.
internal_only_reason: The received IPC type already identifies both sources. Scheme B on #1586 defines the application completion policy.
invariants: A finite zero balance blocks completion. Account exhaustion takes priority over key exhaustion.
A foreground recheck must be able to release either waiting state.

door_reduction.why_not: One page drives verification and renders the rows. The stage and the row presentation now call the same finite-zero predicate; the extra call sites replace inline numeric checks.

generality_proof: Both catalog calls return to the same hook. Only the passed stage schedules notification and return.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own verification stage, recheck lifetime and the delayed connected receipt.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: First paste consumes both fields of the received result.
Refresh of the saved credential flows through the same stage decision.
The send-side account reader does not complete onboarding.

recurrence.reason: Every saved key or new key with a finite zero limit can produce the same false receipt.
same_class_scan: door-map useApimartVerification locates the shared page entry.
rg keyQuota and recheckApimartBalance connects the two IPC results to the check rows and the receipt.

prevention.invariant: Only a result with no explicitly exhausted resource can schedule a connected receipt.
prevention.failure_mode: Keep the appropriate warning visible until a new check resolves it.
prevention.strategy: Compare account first, then key, with one finite-zero predicate shared with the rows.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the account-only completion rule and numeric-only row warning.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: React manages effects. The onboarding completion decision belongs to Nomi.

migration: Verification stages are ephemeral. Existing credentials are rechecked through the original bridge.
residual_risks: Tests provide IPC snapshots. No live account or paid generation is exercised.
